title: Srijika: OpenType-Layout-Reusing Font Restyling for Nine Indic Scripts
abstract: arXiv:2609.05661v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present Srijika, a system for producing installable OpenType fonts for nine Brahmic scripts: Devanagari, Tamil, Bengali, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati, Gurmukhi, and Odia. Rather than generating fonts from scratch, Srijika restyles glyph outlines from shaping-complete template fonts. It preserves the template's cmap and GSUB closure and its GPOS data under a documented metric policy, making every output a complete font by construction. This addresses a central challenge of Indic font generation: hundreds to thousands of conjuncts, half forms, and matra variants must remain mutually consistent under OpenType shaping.   Srijika produces 66 TTFs: 57 curated presets and nine open-vocabulary showcase fonts. All pass the OpenType Sanitizer, while HarfBuzz and CoreText reproduce the template glyph-ID sequences on conjunct-heavy probes. A full-closure audit covering 80,915 glyphs and 54,812 anchors quantifies metric changes. Natural-

translated_title: Srijika：面向九种印度文字的复用OpenType排版的字体重样式化系统
translated_abstract: 我们提出Srijika，一个用于生成九种婆罗米文字可安装OpenType字体的系统，涵盖天城文、泰米尔文、孟加拉文、泰卢固文、卡纳达文、马拉雅拉姆文、古吉拉特文、古尔穆奇文和奥里亚文。Srijika并非从零开始生成字体，而是对排版完整的模板字体的字形轮廓进行重新样式化。它在文档化的度量策略下保留模板的cmap与GSUB闭包以及GPOS数据，使得每个输出在构造上都必然是完整的字体。这解决了印度文字字体生成的核心挑战：数百乃至数千个合体字、半形式和元音符号变体必须在OpenType排版下保持相互一致。Srijika生成了66个TTF文件：57个精心策划的预设字体和九个开放词汇的展示字体。所有字体均通过OpenType Sanitizer检查，并且HarfBuzz和CoreText在合体字密集的测试用例上重现了模板的字形ID序列。一项涵盖80,915个字形和54,812个锚点的全闭包审计量化了度量变化。
tldr: Srijika通过复用排版完整模板字体的OpenType布局数据（cmap、GSUB闭包和GPOS）来重新样式化字形轮廓，为九种印度文字生成构造上保证排版一致性的可安装字体，从而解决了合体字等复杂文本形式难以保持一致的生成难题。
